items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Joe Smith was from the three Smith brothers that played with my brother... Joe Smith never played with me. He played with Fletcher.

ctx.x: But what would we have done with something like that, you know, just a few parts? No way. I don't buy that.

Okay. Here's one other personnel thing you might be able to clear up. "In the spring of 1931 Horace's band was appearing regularly at the Rockland Palace in Harlem. The personnel was pretty stable. The local 710 would -- Washington, D. C., reported Butler, McClung, Sandy Williams, J. Williams, Cole -- "
MR. HENDERSON: John Williams. saxophone.
MR. : John Williams and Cole --
MR. HENDERSON: Rupert Cole.
MR. : Rupert Cole. Then it says a Joseph Smith, and in parentheses it says it "is not known whether this was the…
the place wrong. It was the Dunbar Palace.
